No client changes, no protocol changes — just the JVM replaced by a native binary. Canal Rust keeps Java Canal's protocol semantics and splits the path into 14 independently evolving crates. Protocol 0 lines of client code to change Reuses upstream Canal .proto; Java / Go / Python / C# / Node.js clients connect unchanged. Backpressure Ring buffer + client Ack An in-memory ring buffer keeps events and evicts on overflow; client acknowledgements advance the position so consumers are not flooded. Operate One process, many exits Run multiple destinations in one process; fan out to TCP clients or Kafka, with Prometheus metrics and an Admin API. 02 / FLOW One event, six stages. From MySQL binlog to downstream consumers, every change is caught, checked, queued and delivered until the client acknowledges it. If a stage slows down, the metrics show it. docs/assets/architecture-en.svg · v2.2.0 Ingestcanal-binlog connects to MySQL, pulls binlog and converts it to a unified event model. docs.text: Project / About A data canal,kept by a crab. Canal Rust emulates the MySQL slave protocol, sends dump requests to the master, parses binary log events and serves them to downstream consumers over protobuf. It keeps Java Canal's wire protocol and swaps the runtime for Rust. Apache-2.0Cargo workspacev2.2.0since 2026-07-30 01 / OVERVIEW One change,delivered end to end. MySQL keeps producing changes upstream; downstream consumers can fall behind. Something in the middle has to control the flow, keep events and confirm delivery. Canal Rust splits the job into 14 crates, each independently testable. Crates14independently built Rust crates Rust source~8.4klines of source Test code~3.9klines of tests Tests389unit / integration tests Protobuf2upstream Canal definitions Version2.2.0workspace version Clippy0warnings LicenseApachecode, version 2.0 Canal Rust is not another CDC product. It is a deliberately restrained rewrite: same protocol, same semantics, new implementation. Fourteen crates cover the full path: ingest → parse → filter → store → egress → ack. The wire protocol is identical to Java Canal, so existing Java / Go / Python / C# / Node.js clients connect without changes. mysql_cdc connects to MySQL 5.1–8.0 and MariaDB with position and GTID modes. Parsed events pass through regex filters, a ring buffer, and TCP or Kafka exits before reaching consumers. Rust brings clearer ownership, a lighter runtime and crate boundaries that can be tested and replaced independently. The 14 crates form a one-way dependency graph — a stable home for the mascot too. 02 / ARCHITECTURE Six layers,one direction. From MySQL to a TCP client or Kafka, each crate does one job. Layers meet at an explicit event model, and an exception in one does not block graceful shutdown of the others. Architecture / 14-crate Rust workspace · v2.2.0 LayerCrateResponsibility Ingestcanal-binlogConnect to MySQL, pull binlog and convert it to a unified event model Processcanal-filter · canal-sinkRegex table/schema filtering and fan-out to multiple exits Egresscanal-store · canal-server · canal-connectorRing buffer, TCP protocol service and Kafka delivery Orchestratecanal-instanceManage multiple destinations; each owns a complete path Operatecanal-admin · canal-prometheus · canal-cliControl API, metrics endpoint and CLI entry point Foundationcanal-common · canal-proto · canal-metaTypes and lifecycle, protobuf generation and schema cache data flow MySQL Master │ binlog dump (mysql_cdc) ▼ canal-binlog ──▶ canal-filter ──▶ canal-sink ──┬──▶ canal-store ──▶ canal-server ──▶ client └──▶ canal-connector ──▶ Kafka canal-instance manages destinations; canal-admin / canal-prometheus expose control and metrics. Instance, session and process are independent tracks: an error in one does not block graceful shutdown of the others. Lifecycle / instance · session · process Explore the 14 capabilities → 03 / DECISIONS Every choice,fewer surprises. Wire compatibility is a hard constraint. Everything else serves it: a mature CDC library, pure-Rust protobuf, a dependency-free ring buffer and runtime state visible through tracing and Prometheus. headings: Know the edges,then decide how to use it.
From a capability listto a running event.
docs.text: Capabilities / Features 14 crates,14 capabilities, one path. A capability is a position in the pipeline: ingest, processing, egress, orchestration, operations, foundation. Each layer does one job; together they move changes. 14 capabilities6 layers389 tests0 clippy warnings 01 / MAP The capability map. Fourteen capabilities map one-to-one to 14 crates, in four groups: ingest, processing, egress, and operations. Ingest and processing decide what you can get; egress and operations decide how far it goes and how clearly you can see it. Capabilities / 14 crates · v2.2.0 02 / CAPABILITIES Four groups,each a stretch. From the MySQL master to a client or Kafka, each crate has a clear place in the path. The groups follow data flow, not directory layout. Ingest01 — 03 canal-binlogConnects to MySQL 5.1–8.0 / MariaDB, pulls binlog and maps TableMap into a unified event model.mysql_cdc · position / GTID canal-protoReuses upstream Canal .proto and generates Rust types with prost-build for wire compatibility.CanalProtocol.proto · EntryProtocol.proto canal-metaTracks DDL changes and caches table schemas so the parser does not query the master each time.DDL tracking · schema cache Processing04 — 06 canal-filterRegex-based table/schema include and exclude filters keep unwanted changes out of the path.EventFilter · regex canal-sinkEvent fan-out: one change can enter the ring buffer and multiple connectors at once.fan-out · Arc canal-storeAn in-memory ring buffer keeps events, evicts on overflow, and advances the position after client Ack.VecDeque · ack Egress07 — 09 canal-serverCanal wire protocol TCP service: handshake, auth, subscribe, get and ack, compatible with Java Canal clients.tokio codec · protobuf canal-connectorKafka connector that serializes change events as JSON flat messages.rdkafka · JSON flat message canal-clientRust client SDK; subscribe to events and consume them as a stream.connect · subscribe · stream Orchestration & operations10 — 14 canal-instanceRuns multiple destinations in one process; each instance has its own binlog, store and filter.lifecycle · feed loop canal-adminREST Admin API: instance start/stop, status queries, landing page and /pet.svg.axum · /health · /api/instances canal-prometheusExposes parsed / filtered / dispatched / error counters and the active-instance gauge.Prometheus · /metrics canal-cliCommand-line entry: server / dump / pet; binary name canal-rust.clap · config loading canal-commonBase types, errors, lifecycle abstractions and Xiaoyun's ASCII and SVG definitions.types · lifecycle · pet 03 / ITERATION From running,to holding the line. The project completed three phases in July 2026, then went through review rounds, an infrastructure refactor, and finally the mascot runtime. The path was not written at once; it was made stable stage by stage. 2026-07-30Phase 1 · core path v1.0.0common, proto, binlog, filter, sink, store, server, client and cli landed; one change ran end to end. 2026-07-30Phase 2 · orchestration and exits v1.0.2canal-instance, canal-connector, canal-prometheus, canal-meta and canal-admin added multi-instance, Kafka, metrics and the control plane. 2026-07-31Phase 3 · tests and review v1.0.3The path took shape with 77 tests and 18 commits; v1.0.4–v1.1.8 then ran continuous review and correctness fixes. 2026-07-31Infrastructure refactor v2.0.0Configuration, error handling and lifecycle unified; the v2.0.1–v2.0.6 patch series continued tightening edges. 2026-09-26Mascot and infrastructure v2.1.0Mascot redraw, fixes for blocking and correctness issues, Docker / CI foundation. 2026-09-26Mascot enters the runtime v2.2.0canal-rust pet, --help and Admin GET /pet.svg; CI / Docker install protoc; 389 tests pass with 0 Clippy warnings. 04 / LIMITS Know the edges,then decide how to use it. These limits come from upstream dependencies or defaults; they are not hidden traps. Check each one before deployment, especially plaintext MySQL and the Admin bind address. SecurityMySQL connections are plaintext Upstream mysql_cdc 0.2.1 has no TLS and panics on any SslMode other than Disabled. Credentials and binlog data are unencrypted; use a trusted network or an SSH tunnel. AuthLimited auth plugins Only mysql_native_password and caching_sha2_password are supported. An account using sha256_password will fail; create the account with an explicit plugin. BindAdmin is local by default Without server.admin_bind, the Admin API is fixed at 127.0.0.1:{port+1}. Containers and remote clients need an explicit bind and firewall protection. Metrics/metrics has no auth by default The metrics endpoint warns when no authentication is configured. It binds to loopback by default; if exposed, keep it on a private network or behind an authenticating proxy. See Installation and Usage for the full security and deployment notes. NEXT From a capability listto a running event. Once you know the edges, install protoc, clone the repository and let Xiaoyun take the lock locally. Installation → Changelog

docs.description: Canal Rust installation: prerequisites, protoc, build, MySQL configuration, canal.yaml, start, Docker and troubleshooting.
docs.text: Get started / Installation Connect the canalto your MySQL. From clone to first event takes about five minutes. You need Rust 1.85+, protoc and MySQL 5.7+ / 8.0 with ROW binlog. Kafka is optional. Rust 1.85+protoc requiredMySQL 5.7+~5 min ON THIS PAGE Requirements Get the source Build Configure MySQL Configure canal.yaml Run the server Docker Verify Troubleshooting Requirements Rust 1.85+. clap, getrandom and other dependencies use edition 2024; older toolchains cannot build the current Cargo.lock. protoc (Protocol Buffers compiler). canal-proto/build.rs drives prost-build; without protoc every build fails. MySQL 5.7+ / 8.0 with binlog enabled and binlog_format=ROW; MariaDB is supported. Kafka (optional), only when you need a message-queue exit. Ports: 11111 Canal TCP, 11112 Admin API, 9090 Prometheus (all configurable). install dependencies # Rust (if not installed) curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh # Debian / Ubuntu sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler # macOS brew install protobuf Without protoc, builds fail with Could not find 'protoc'. Install it before retrying. Get the source The repository contains 14 workspace crates, proto definitions, Docker configuration and documentation. terminal git clone https://github.com/erikwang2013/canal-rust.git cd canal-rust Build terminal cargo build --release # binary: target/release/canal-rust ./target/release/canal-rust --version ./target/release/canal-rust pet canal-rust pet prints the ASCII mascot and the places where Xiaoyun lives in the code. Configure MySQL Create a replication account for Canal Rust and confirm that binlog is enabled. MySQL CREATE USER 'canal'@'%' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'canal'; GRANT SELECT, REPLICATION SLAVE, REPLICATION CLIENT ON *.* TO 'canal'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES; SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log_bin'; SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'binlog_format'; SHOW MASTER STATUS; If binlog_format is not ROW, set it in MySQL configuration and restart: my.cnf [mysqld] server-id = 1 log-bin = mysql-bin binlog_format = ROW Connections are plaintext. Upstream mysql_cdc 0.2.1 has no TLS; credentials and binlog data are unencrypted. Use a trusted network or an SSH tunnel. Auth plugins are limited to mysql_native_password and caching_sha2_password. Configure canal.yaml Copy the template and adjust it for your environment: terminal cp canal.yaml.example canal.yaml canal.yaml canal: mysql: host: "127.0.0.1" port: 3306 username: "canal" password: "canal" store: buffer_size: 16384 server: bind: "0.0.0.0:11111" metrics_bind: "127.0.0.1:9090" # admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112" logging: level: "info" format: "json" FieldDefaultDescription server_id1001MySQL replication server ID; unique in the cluster start_journal_namemysql-bin.000001Starting binlog file start_position4Starting position store.buffer_size16384Ring buffer capacity server.bind127.0.0.1:11111Canal TCP listen address server.metrics_bind127.0.0.1:9090Prometheus /metrics address server.admin_bind127.0.0.1:{port+1}Admin API; loopback unless set server.idle_timeout_secs3600Idle client disconnect timeout filter.pattern.*\..*Schema/table include regex auth_tokenemptyEmpty = authentication disabled Run the server terminal ./target/release/canal-rust server --config canal.yaml # or cargo run --release -- server --config canal.yaml Startup logs include Xiaoyun is on duty, guarding the data canal, followed by the Canal TCP, metrics and Admin API addresses. Ctrl-C triggers graceful shutdown; the binlog task waits up to 5 seconds. SubcommandPurpose serverStart Canal TCP, metrics and Admin API dumpConnect to MySQL and print binlog events petMeet Xiaoyun and locate the vector original Docker Compose builds the image, publishes 11111 / 11112 / 9090 and mounts docker/canal.yaml. The default config reaches a MySQL on the host through host.docker.internal. terminal docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d # logs docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f canal-rust Edit docker/canal.yaml and restart the container; no image rebuild is needed. Inside a container, bind to 0.0.0.0 or published ports cannot reach the service. The Docker config already does this. Verify terminal # health curl http://127.0.0.1:11112/health # instance status curl http://127.0.0.1:11112/api/instances # metrics curl http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics # Admin landing page: Xiaoyun and live status # http://127.0.0.1:11112/ /health returns status: "UP" with version and uptime; /metrics exposes canal_events_parsed_total, canal_events_dispatched_total and canal_instances_active. Seeing Xiaoyun and UP means the Admin API is running. Next, write a client or use canal-rust dump to watch the binlog. Troubleshooting SymptomFix Could not find 'protoc'Install protobuf-compiler / protobuf and confirm protoc --version. sha256_password auth plugin is not supportedUse mysql_native_password or caching_sha2_password. Cannot connect to MySQLCheck binlog is on, format is ROW, the account has REPLICATION privileges, and server_id is unique. Admin is unreachable from a container / remote hostSet server.admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112" and check the firewall. Address already in useChange server.bind, metrics_bind or admin_bind. No eventsConfirm writes occur; use canal-rust dump; check filter.pattern. Still stuck? See Usage or search GitHub Issues. Continue to usage →

docs.description: Canal Rust 安装文档：环境要求、protoc 安装、构建、MySQL 配置、canal.yaml、启动、Docker 部署与故障排查。
headings: 把运河，接到你的 MySQL 上。
docs.text: Get started / 安装文档 把运河，接到你的 MySQL 上。 从 clone 到第一条事件，大约五分钟。需要 Rust 1.85+、protoc，以及一个开启了 ROW 格式 binlog 的 MySQL 5.7+ / 8.0。Kafka 是可选的。 Rust 1.85+protoc requiredMySQL 5.7+~5 min ON THIS PAGE 环境要求 获取源码 构建 配置 MySQL 配置 canal.yaml 启动服务 Docker 部署 验证 故障排查 环境要求 Rust 1.85+。依赖链中的 clap、getrandom 等已使用 edition 2024，低于 1.85 无法构建当前 Cargo.lock。 protoc（Protocol Buffers 编译器）。canal-proto/build.rs 通过 prost-build 生成代码，缺了它任何编译都会失败。 MySQL 5.7+ / 8.0，开启 binlog 且格式为 ROW；MariaDB 也受支持。 Kafka（可选），仅在需要消息队列出口时安装。 端口：11111 Canal TCP、11112 Admin API、9090 Prometheus（均可配置）。 安装依赖 # Rust（如果还没装） curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh # Debian / Ubuntu sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler # macOS brew install protobuf 缺少 protoc 时，编译会报 Could not find 'protoc'。这不是 Rust 版本问题， 先把 protoc 装好再重试。 获取源码 仓库包含 14 个 workspace crate、proto 定义、Docker 配置与文档。 terminal git clone https://github.com/erikwang2013/canal-rust.git cd canal-rust 构建 terminal cargo build --release # 二进制位于 target/release/canal-rust ./target/release/canal-rust --version ./target/release/canal-rust pet canal-rust pet 会打印 ASCII 版小运，并告诉你它都住在代码里的哪些位置。 配置 MySQL 创建一个供 Canal Rust 使用的复制账号，并确认 binlog 已开启。 MySQL CREATE USER 'canal'@'%' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'canal'; GRANT SELECT, REPLICATION SLAVE, REPLICATION CLIENT ON *.* TO 'canal'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES; SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'log_bin'; SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'binlog_format'; SHOW MASTER STATUS; 如果 binlog_format 不是 ROW，在 MySQL 配置中设置后重启： my.cnf [mysqld] server-id = 1 log-bin = mysql-bin binlog_format = ROW 连接是明文的。上游 mysql_cdc 0.2.1 未实现 TLS，账号密码与 binlog 数据都不加密。只在可信内网使用；跨网段请套 SSH 隧道。认证插件仅支持 mysql_native_password 与 caching_sha2_password。 配置 canal.yaml 从模板复制一份，按实际环境修改： terminal cp canal.yaml.example canal.yaml canal.yaml canal: mysql: host: "127.0.0.1" port: 3306 username: "canal" password: "canal" store: buffer_size: 16384 server: bind: "0.0.0.0:11111" metrics_bind: "127.0.0.1:9090" # admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112" logging: level: "info" format: "json" 字段默认说明 server_id1001MySQL 复制 server_id，集群内需唯一 start_journal_namemysql-bin.000001起始 binlog 文件 start_position4起始位点 store.buffer_size16384ring buffer 容量 server.bind127.0.0.1:11111Canal TCP 监听地址 server.metrics_bind127.0.0.1:9090Prometheus /metrics 地址 server.admin_bind127.0.0.1:{主端口+1}Admin API；不设则仅本机可达 server.idle_timeout_secs3600客户端空闲断开时间 filter.pattern.*\..*库表 include 正则 auth_token空空 = 不启用认证 启动服务 terminal ./target/release/canal-rust server --config canal.yaml # 或者 cargo run --release -- server --config canal.yaml 启动日志会出现 小运 is on duty, guarding the data canal，并分别打印 Canal TCP、 Metrics 与 Admin API 的监听地址。按 Ctrl-C 触发优雅关闭，binlog 任务最多等待 5 秒。 子命令用途 server启动完整服务：Canal TCP、Metrics、Admin API dump直接连接 MySQL，把 binlog 事件打印到终端 pet见一见小运，并查看矢量原图的位置 Docker 部署 compose 会构建镜像、发布 11111 / 11112 / 9090 三个端口，并把 docker/canal.yaml 挂载进容器。默认通过 host.docker.internal 连接宿主机上的 MySQL。 terminal docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d # 查看日志 docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f canal-rust 修改 docker/canal.yaml 后重启容器即可生效，无需重新构建镜像。 容器内必须监听 0.0.0.0，否则宿主机的端口映射连不上。Docker 配置已经这样设置； 如果你自己写 compose，请保留 bind、metrics_bind 与 admin_bind。 验证 terminal # 健康检查 curl http://127.0.0.1:11112/health # 实例状态 curl http://127.0.0.1:11112/api/instances # 指标 curl http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics # 浏览器打开 Admin 落地页，可以看到小运和实时状态 # http://127.0.0.1:11112/ /health 返回 status: "UP" 与版本 / 运行时长； /metrics 中可以看到 canal_events_parsed_total、 canal_events_dispatched_total 与 canal_instances_active。 看到小运和 UP，就说明 Admin API 已经起来了。下一步可以写一个客户端， 或者用 canal-rust dump 先看看 binlog 里有什么。 故障排查 症状处理 Could not find 'protoc'安装 protobuf-compiler / protobuf，确认 protoc --version 可用。 sha256_password auth plugin is not supported改用 mysql_native_password 或 caching_sha2_password 建账号。 连接不上 MySQL确认 binlog 已开启、格式为 ROW、账号具备 REPLICATION 权限、server_id 未被占用。 容器 / 远程打不开 Admin显式设置 server.admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112"，并检查防火墙。 Address already in use修改 server.bind / metrics_bind / admin_bind 的端口。 没有事件输出确认有写入发生；用 canal-rust dump 直接观察 binlog；检查 filter.pattern 是否过滤掉了目标库表。 还有问题？先看 使用说明 的配置章节，或到 GitHub Issues 搜索。 继续看使用说明 →

docs.title: Usage · Canal Rust
docs.description: Canal Rust usage: Rust client, CLI, Kafka, multi-instance deployment, Prometheus metrics and Admin API.
headings: Subscribe to a change,starting from the client.
docs.text: Usage / Guide Subscribe to a change,starting from the client. Once the server is running, a client connects to the Canal TCP port, declares a destination, and reads events one by one. Existing Canal clients can connect too, because the protocol has not changed. Canal wire protocolRust SDKKafka / TCPPrometheus ON THIS PAGE Rust client CLI Kafka Multi-instance Prometheus Admin API Runtime behavior Development Subscribe with the Rust client canal-client is the repository's Rust SDK. After connecting, subscribe to a destination and read events as a stream; each next_event() returns one event. main.rs use canal_client::CanalClient; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { let mut client = CanalClient::new("127.0.0.1", 11111) .with_destination("example"); client.connect().await?; let mut stream = client.subscribe(None).await?; while let Some(Ok(event)) = stream.next_event().await { println!("{}: {} @ {}.{}", event.journal_name, event.position, event.schema_name, event.table_name); } Ok(()) } Events carry the journal name, position, schema, table and DML / DDL information. The full example and end-to-end test live in crates/canal-client/tests/e2e.rs. Java / Go / Python / C# / Node.js clients need no changes: Canal Rust reuses upstream CanalProtocol.proto and EntryProtocol.proto and keeps the wire protocol compatible. CLI terminal # run the server ./target/release/canal-rust server --config canal.yaml # watch binlog events directly ./target/release/canal-rust dump --config canal.yaml # meet Xiaoyun ./target/release/canal-rust pet dump connects to MySQL and prints each event: count, journal / position, schema.table, entry type and DDL SQL or DML type. It does not start the TCP service, so it is useful for validating credentials and positions before deployment. Scenario 1: sync to Kafka Filter changes from one database and publish them to a Kafka topic as JSON flat messages. canal.yaml canal: mysql: host: "10.0.0.1" username: "replicator" password: "secret" filter: pattern: "mydb\\..*" main.rs use canal_connector::kafka::{KafkaConfig, KafkaConnector}; use canal_instance::{CanalInstance, InstanceConfig}; use canal_common::{FilterPattern, LogPosition}; use std::sync::Arc; let kafka_config = KafkaConfig::new("localhost:9092", "mysql-changes"); let kafka = Arc::new(KafkaConnector::new("kafka-sync", kafka_config).unwrap()); let config = InstanceConfig { destination: "mydb-sync".into(), mysql_host: "10.0.0.1".into(), mysql_port: 3306, mysql_username: "replicator".into(), mysql_password: "secret".into(), mysql_server_id: 2001, start_position: LogPosition::new("mysql-bin.000001", 4), filter: FilterPattern { pattern: "mydb\\..*".into(), black_list: "".into() }, store_buffer_size: 16384, connector_names: vec!["kafka-sync".into()], }; The connector joins the same instance path through canal-sink; one change can enter the ring buffer and Kafka in parallel without blocking. Scenario 2: multi-instance canal-instance runs multiple destinations in one process. Each instance has its own binlog position, filters and store, useful for isolating prod / test in one Canal Rust process. main.rs let manager = InstanceManager::new(); manager.register(CanalInstance::new( InstanceConfig { destination: "prod".into(), ..prod_config }, vec![kafka_prod], )).await; manager.register(CanalInstance::new( InstanceConfig { destination: "test".into(), ..test_config }, vec![kafka_test], )).await; manager.start_all().await?; Instance lifecycle: Created → Starting → Running (feed() loop) → Stopping → Stopped. Scenario 3: Prometheus monitoring terminal curl http://localhost:9090/metrics # canal_events_parsed_total 150000 # canal_events_dispatched_total 146800 # canal_instances_active 2 MetricTypeMeaning canal_events_parsed_totalcounterBinlog events parsed from MySQL canal_events_filtered_totalcounterEvents dropped by filters canal_events_dispatched_totalcounterEvents delivered to connectors canal_dispatch_errors_totalcounterConnector dispatch failures canal_instances_activegaugeActive instances /metrics has no authentication by default. Keep metrics_bind on loopback, on a private network, or behind an authenticating proxy; do not expose it publicly. Scenario 4: Admin API The Admin API listens on main port + 1, loopback only by default. For containers or remote access, set server.admin_bind explicitly: canal.yaml canal: server: bind: "0.0.0.0:11111" admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112" # default: 127.0.0.1:11112 terminal curl http://localhost:11112/health curl http://localhost:11112/api/instances curl -X POST http://localhost:11112/api/instances/default/stop EndpointPurpose GET /Unauthenticated landing page: version, uptime, instance count and Xiaoyun GET /healthHealth check with status / version / uptime_seconds GET /api/instancesInstance list and state POST /api/instances/:name/startStart an instance POST /api/instances/:name/stopStop an instance GET /pet.svgXiaoyun's vector original AdminServer supports with_auth for Authorization: Bearer <token>; the CLI does not enable Admin auth by default. Protect the port with binding and firewall rules. Open http://localhost:11112/ in a browser to see Xiaoyun and live status. Runtime behavior Startup logs print Xiaoyun is on duty, guarding the data canal, then the Canal, metrics and Admin addresses. Binlog events enter an instance in batches: 256 events or a 200ms flush, avoiding per-event downstream wakeups. Ctrl-C triggers graceful shutdown; the binlog task waits up to 5 seconds to flush remaining events. Idle clients are disconnected after idle_timeout_secs (default 3600 seconds). When the ring buffer overflows, the oldest events are evicted; client Ack advances the consumption position. See Installation · canal.yaml for the full configuration reference. Development terminal cargo build --release cargo test --all cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings cargo fmt --check --all cargo doc --open Tests live next to each crate: unit tests in src/tests*.rs or #[cfg(test)] mod tests, integration tests in crates/*/tests/. CI runs fmt, clippy, build, test and doc. At this point a change should have travelled from MySQL to a downstream consumer. The rest is wiring it into your application. docs.description: Canal Rust 使用说明：Rust 客户端连接、CLI 子命令、Kafka 同步、多实例部署、Prometheus 指标与 Admin API。
headings: 订阅一次变更，从客户端开始。
用 Rust 客户端订阅
docs.text: Usage / 使用说明 订阅一次变更，从客户端开始。 服务端跑起来之后，客户端只需连接 Canal TCP 端口、声明 destination，然后一条条取事件。 现有 Canal 客户端也可以直接接入，因为协议没有变。 Canal wire protocolRust SDKKafka / TCPPrometheus ON THIS PAGE Rust 客户端 命令行 同步到 Kafka 多实例 Prometheus 指标 Admin API 运行行为 开发与测试 用 Rust 客户端订阅 canal-client 是仓库自带的 Rust SDK。连接后订阅 destination， 事件会以流的方式返回；每次 next_event() 取到一条。 main.rs use canal_client::CanalClient; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { let mut client = CanalClient::new("127.0.0.1", 11111) .with_destination("example"); client.connect().await?; let mut stream = client.subscribe(None).await?; while let Some(Ok(event)) = stream.next_event().await { println!("{}: {} @ {}.{}", event.journal_name, event.position, event.schema_name, event.table_name); } Ok(()) } 事件里包含 journal 名、位点、库名、表名与 DML / DDL 信息。完整示例与端到端测试在 crates/canal-client/tests/e2e.rs。 Java / Go / Python / C# / Node.js 客户端无需改动：Canal Rust 复用上游 CanalProtocol.proto 与 EntryProtocol.proto，保持 wire protocol 兼容。 命令行 terminal # 启动服务 ./target/release/canal-rust server --config canal.yaml # 直接观察 binlog 事件 ./target/release/canal-rust dump --config canal.yaml # 见见小运 ./target/release/canal-rust pet dump 会连接 MySQL 并逐条打印事件：计数、journal / position、schema.table、 entry type，以及 DDL SQL 或 DML 类型。它不启动 TCP 服务，适合在部署前确认账号权限和位点。 场景 1：同步到 Kafka 把某个库的变更过滤出来，投递到 Kafka topic。消息格式是 JSON flat message。 canal.yaml canal: mysql: host: "10.0.0.1" username: "replicator" password: "secret" filter: pattern: "mydb\\..*" main.rs use canal_connector::kafka::{KafkaConfig, KafkaConnector}; use canal_instance::{CanalInstance, InstanceConfig}; use canal_common::{FilterPattern, LogPosition}; use std::sync::Arc; let kafka_config = KafkaConfig::new("localhost:9092", "mysql-changes"); let kafka = Arc::new(KafkaConnector::new("kafka-sync", kafka_config).unwrap()); let config = InstanceConfig { destination: "mydb-sync".into(), mysql_host: "10.0.0.1".into(), mysql_port: 3306, mysql_username: "replicator".into(), mysql_password: "secret".into(), mysql_server_id: 2001, start_position: LogPosition::new("mysql-bin.000001", 4), filter: FilterPattern { pattern: "mydb\\..*".into(), black_list: "".into() }, store_buffer_size: 16384, connector_names: vec!["kafka-sync".into()], }; 连接器通过 canal-sink 扇出接入同一条实例链路；同一个变更可以同时进入 ring buffer 与 Kafka，互不阻塞。 场景 2：多实例 canal-instance 允许一个进程运行多个 destination。每个实例有自己的 binlog 位点、过滤规则与 store，适合在一个 Canal Rust 进程里隔离 prod / test。 main.rs let manager = InstanceManager::new(); manager.register(CanalInstance::new( InstanceConfig { destination: "prod".into(), ..prod_config }, vec![kafka_prod], )).await; manager.register(CanalInstance::new( InstanceConfig { destination: "test".into(), ..test_config }, vec![kafka_test], )).await; manager.start_all().await?; 实例生命周期：已创建 → 启动中 → 运行中（feed() 循环）→ 停止中 → 已停止。 场景 3：Prometheus 监控 terminal curl http://localhost:9090/metrics # canal_events_parsed_total 150000 # canal_events_dispatched_total 146800 # canal_instances_active 2 指标类型含义 canal_events_parsed_totalcounter从 MySQL 解析出的 binlog 事件数 canal_events_filtered_totalcounter被过滤规则丢弃的事件数 canal_events_dispatched_totalcounter成功分发到 connector 的事件数 canal_dispatch_errors_totalcounterconnector 分发失败数 canal_instances_activegauge活跃实例数 /metrics 默认无认证。保持 metrics_bind 在回环地址，或放在内网 / 反向代理鉴权之后，不要直接暴露到公网。 场景 4：Admin API Admin API 默认监听 主端口 + 1 且仅绑定回环地址。要远程或容器访问，必须显式配置 server.admin_bind： canal.yaml canal: server: bind: "0.0.0.0:11111" admin_bind: "0.0.0.0:11112" # 不配置 = 127.0.0.1:11112 terminal curl http://localhost:11112/health curl http://localhost:11112/api/instances curl -X POST http://localhost:11112/api/instances/default/stop 端点用途 GET /无需 token 的落地页：版本、运行时长、实例计数与小运 GET /health健康检查，返回 status / version / uptime_seconds GET /api/instances实例列表与状态 POST /api/instances/:name/start启动指定实例 POST /api/instances/:name/stop停止指定实例 GET /pet.svg直接返回小运矢量原图 AdminServer 支持通过 with_auth 启用 Authorization: Bearer <token> 校验；CLI 默认未启用 Admin 鉴权，请通过绑定地址与防火墙保护管理端口。 直接用浏览器打开 http://localhost:11112/，会看到小运和实时状态。 运行行为 启动日志打印 小运 is on duty, guarding the data canal，随后分别报告 Canal、Metrics、Admin 的监听地址。 binlog 事件按批进入实例：攒到 256 条或每 200ms 刷一次，避免单条事件频繁唤醒下游。 按 Ctrl-C 触发优雅关闭；binlog 任务最多等待 5 秒，把剩余事件刷完后再退出。 客户端空闲超过 idle_timeout_secs（默认 3600 秒）会被断开。 ring buffer 容量溢出时自动淘汰最旧事件；客户端 Ack 用于推进消费位点。 完整配置字段与默认值见 安装文档 · 配置 canal.yaml。 开发与测试 terminal cargo build --release cargo test --all cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings cargo fmt --check --all cargo doc --open 测试不集中放在顶层 tests/，而是与源码同 crate 维护：单元测试在 src/tests*.rs 或 #[cfg(test)] mod tests，集成测试在 crates/*/tests/。CI 会执行 fmt、clippy、build、test 与 doc。 到这里，一条变更应该已经从 MySQL 走到了下游。剩下的就是把它接进你的业务。 看看每个版本改了什么 →
